an5.34:1.1: On one occasion the Blessed One was dwelling at Vesālī in the hall with the peaked roof in the Great Wood.
an5.34:1.2: Then Sīha the general approached the Blessed One, paid homage to him, sat down to one side, and said:
an5.34:1.3: “Is it possible, Bhante, to point out a directly visible fruit of giving?”
an5.34:2.1: “It is, Sīha,” the Blessed One said.
an5.34:2.2: (1) “A donor, Sīha, a munificent giver, is dear and agreeable to many people.
an5.34:2.3: This is a directly visible fruit of giving.
an5.34:3.1: (2) “Again, good persons resort to a donor, a munificent giver.
an5.34:3.2: This, too, is a directly visible fruit of giving.
an5.34:4.1: (3) “Again, a donor, a munificent giver, acquires a good reputation.
an5.34:4.2: This, too, is a directly visible fruit of giving.
an5.34:5.1: (4) “Again, whatever assembly a donor, a munificent giver, approaches—whether of khattiyas, brahmins, householders, or ascetics—he approaches it confidently and composed.
an5.34:5.2: This too is a directly visible fruit of giving.
an5.34:6.1: (5) “Again, with the breakup of the body, after death, a donor, a munificent giver, is reborn in a good destination, in a heavenly world.
an5.34:6.2: This is a fruit of giving pertaining to future lives.”
an5.34:7.1: When this was said, Sīha the general said to the Blessed One:
an5.34:7.2: “Bhante, I do not go by faith in the Blessed One concerning those four directly visible fruits of giving declared by him. I know them, too.
an5.34:7.3: For I am a donor, a munificent giver, and I am dear and agreeable to many people.
an5.34:7.4: I am a donor, a munificent giver, and many good persons resort to me.
an5.34:7.5: I am a donor, a munificent giver, and I have acquired a good reputation as a donor, sponsor, and supporter of the Saṅgha.
an5.34:7.6: I am a donor, a munificent giver, and whatever assembly I approach—whether of khattiyas, brahmins, householders, or ascetics—I approach it confidently and composed.
an5.34:7.7: I do not go by faith in the Blessed One concerning these four directly visible fruits of giving declared by him. I know them, too.
an5.34:7.8: But when the Blessed One tells me:
an5.34:7.9: ‘Sīha, with the breakup of the body, after death, a donor, a munificent giver, is reborn in a good destination, in a heavenly world,’ I do not know this, and here I go by faith in the Blessed One.”
an5.34:7.10: “So it is, Sīha, so it is!
an5.34:7.11: With the breakup of the body, after death, a donor, a munificent giver, is reborn in a good destination, in a heavenly world.”
an5.34:8.1: By giving, he becomes dear and many resort to him.
an5.34:8.2: He attains a good reputation and his fame increases.
an5.34:8.3: The generous man is composed and confidently enters the assembly.
an5.34:9.1: Therefore, seeking happiness, wise persons give gifts,
an5.34:9.2: having removed the stain of miserliness.
an5.34:9.3: When they are settled in the triple heaven, for a long time they delight
an5.34:10.1: Having taken the opportunity to do wholesome deeds, passing from here,
an5.34:10.3: where they delight, rejoice, and enjoy themselves,
an5.34:10.4: furnished with the five objects of sensual pleasure.
an5.34:10.5: Having fulfilled the word of the unattached Stable One,
an5.34:10.6: the Fortunate One’s disciples rejoice in heaven.
